web.summary: To present your offer credibly and make it easier for visitors to reach out.

A consistent experience on every screen
A maintainable base for future changes

automation.label: AI and automation
automation.title: Automating repetitive tasks with a clear method.
automation.summary: To reduce double entry, make tracking more reliable, and improve how information flows.
automation.description: We analyze a process before connecting forms, documents, notifications, and tools. AI is used only when it brings clear, controllable value.
outcomes: Fewer repetitive manual steps
More consistent tracking
Better visibility into each step of the process

audit.label: Audit and scoping
audit.title: Clarifying the need, the risks, and the next decision.
audit.summary: A structured analysis to understand the current state, prioritize a useful scope, and prepare a roadmap without presuming the solution.
audit.description: We bring together the available facts, usage, constraints, and dependencies to produce verifiable findings, priorities, and the next decisions. The engagement can conclude without a later build.
outcomes: A better-documented current situation
A prioritized scope and explicit limits
A roadmap adapted to the available level of evidence

process.title: Define
process.text: Clarify the question, the sources, and the engagement's limits.

process.title: Gather
process.text: Review authorized documents, interfaces, and accounts.

process.title: Analyze
process.text: Separate facts, assumptions, risks, and dependencies.

process.title: Prioritize
process.text: Compare scenarios and the useful scope.

process.title: Report
process.text: Hand off findings, decisions, and the roadmap.

idealFor: Preparing a redesign without a clear scope
Understanding why a journey or process performs poorly
Prioritizing an MVP before building it
Comparing scenarios without immediately committing to development
deliverables: Architecture, journeys, or mapping depending on the engagement
considerations: Conclusions depend on the access and information strictly necessary for the engagement.
No advanced cybersecurity audit or legal opinion is included.
A later build is neither included nor guaranteed.
A firm estimate requires a validated scope.

seo.title: Digital audit and scoping
seo.description: Structured audit of websites, journeys, and processes to clarify findings, prioritize an MVP, and prepare a roadmap.

mobile.label: Mobile app development
mobile.title: A mobile app built for real use, not a demo.
mobile.summary: To offer a service accessible from the phone, with a smooth experience on iOS and Android.
mobile.description: We build mobile apps with React Native and Expo: authentication, real-time data, geolocation, and notifications based on the project's real needs.
outcomes: An app usable on iOS and Android from a single codebase
Reliably synchronized data
A mobile journey designed for thumb-first use

process.title: Scoping
process.text: Mobile use cases, target platforms, and technical constraints.

process.title: Prototype
process.text: Key journeys and screens validated before full development.

process.title: Build
process.text: Development with automated tests and continuous integration.

process.title: Validate
process.text: Testing on real devices and adjustments.

process.title: Release
process.text: Build preparation and support for app store submission.

idealFor: Offering a service accessible on the go
Adding a mobile layer to an existing platform
Building a mobile app end to end with a reliable backend
Centralizing an experience currently limited to the web
considerations: App store submission depends on timelines and rules set by Apple and Google.
Advanced native features (payments, complex notifications) need to be scoped upfront.
A reliable backend is required for connected features.

seo.title: Mobile app development
seo.description: React Native mobile apps for small and medium businesses and organizations: authentication, real-time data, and notifications.

A technical foundation ready for new features

infra.label: Infrastructure, hosting, and DevOps
infra.title: Hosting under control, from deployment to follow-up.
infra.summary: To host and deploy your applications on a Linux infrastructure that's understood and documented.
infra.description: We deploy on Linux servers (containers, Proxmox), with an Nginx reverse proxy, TLS certificates, and reproducible deployment scripts.
outcomes: Documented, reproducible hosting
A deployment that doesn't depend on a single person
An isolated, secured environment per service
